note: This file is the honest contract for what Ariana can and cannot do on social media. Every supported action names the real method it maps to. Every unsupported action carries a reason a human can read. If a platform or action is not here, it does not exist in this integration — do not add UI for it. The engine service (socialcrabs-service/src/capabilities.json) holds a byte-identical copy; test/social-manifest.test.js fails if the two ever drift.

view_profile.description: Read a public profile: name, bio, headline, and follower/connection counts where the profile page exposes them.

view_posts.description: List an account's recent post URLs.

comment.description: Post a public comment under a post. On X this is a reply to the tweet.

reply.description: Reply to a specific comment or message thread.

connect.description: Send a connection request, optionally with a short note.

dm.description: Send a direct message to one person.

repost.description: Repost / retweet / share someone else's post.

engagement.description: Check follower / following / connection counts for an account.

delete_post.description: Delete one of your own posts.

delete_comment.description: Delete one of your own comments.

search.reason: The Instagram handler has no search method — it can open a profile or a post URL, but cannot look up posts by keyword.

view_feed.reason: The integration has no home-feed method for Instagram. It scrolls to warm the session up but never exposes the feed as data.

reply.reason: Instagram comments cannot be targeted individually — the handler can add a comment to a post, but not reply to one specific comment.

connect.reason: Connection requests are a LinkedIn concept; Instagram has no equivalent action in the integration.

dm.notes: One message to one person. No bulk.

read_dms.reason: The integration can send a DM but has no inbox reader — it cannot list or read conversations.

post.reason: There is no publish method on the Instagram handler (feed posting / reels / stories). Ariana cannot post to Instagram through this integration.

repost.reason: Instagram has no repost/reshare method in the handler.

notifications.reason: The integration does not open the notifications tab.

engagement.returns: followers, following, post count as shown on the profile page

delete_post.reason: No delete method exists for Instagram in the integration.

delete_comment.reason: No delete method exists for Instagram in the integration.

search.reason: The X handler has no search method — it can open a tweet URL or a profile, but cannot search.

view_profile.returns: display name, bio, followers, following, tweet count, join date

view_posts.reason: The X handler reads profiles, not an account's post list. It can act on a tweet when given its URL.

view_feed.reason: The integration has no home-timeline method for X.

comment.notes: On X, commenting on a tweet is replying to it.

reply.notes: A reply in X is the same operation as a comment on the tweet.

connect.reason: Connection requests are a LinkedIn concept; X has no equivalent action in the integration.

dm.notes: One message to one person. No bulk.

read_dms.reason: The integration can send a DM but has no inbox reader.

post.notes: Text only — the integration has no media upload path.

notifications.reason: The integration does not open the notifications tab.

engagement.returns: followers, following, tweet count as shown on the profile page

delete_post.reason: No delete method exists for X in the integration.

delete_comment.reason: No delete method exists for X in the integration.

search.returns: post URLs and previews, newest first
search.notes: Scrolls the content search results; this is the slowest read action.

view_profile.returns: full name, headline, location, connections, current company and title

view_feed.reason: The integration has no home-feed method for LinkedIn.

reply.reason: LinkedIn comments cannot be targeted individually — the handler can comment on a post, not reply to one specific comment.

connect.notes: Connection request with an optional short note.

dm.notes: One message to one person. No bulk.

repost.reason: LinkedIn has no repost method in the handler.

notifications.reason: The integration does not open the notifications tab.

delete_comment.reason: No delete method exists for LinkedIn in the integration.
